release.title: Selected Ambient Works Volume II
release.notes:
This version has different text and colors on the CDs compared to [r=6282031] and [r=4971499] All printed text on both CDs: ℗ AND © WARP RECORDS 1994
Track 2-1 was previously released on the compilation [r=51236].
All tracks (except track 2-1) are untitled, and are instead represented by photographs. On the artwork are six pie charts, representing the six sides of [url=http://www.discogs.com/release/704310]the vinyl edition[/url], each pie slice representing a track (track length deciding the size of the pie slice), clockwise from top. By comparing each colour-coded pie chart with the small pie symbol on each photograph, it is possible to match track to photograph.
The artwork indicates 25 tracks, as on the vinyl and [url=http://www.discogs.com/release/864752]cassette[/url] edition, but there are in fact only 24 tracks on the CDs. The missing track, represented by the 19th pie slice, can be found on the CD compilation [r=59922].
Contains a booklet which folds out into a two sided six-panel display and a separate one-panel card.

format.name: File
format.text: Radiate is the debut album from UK-based EDM artist Howard Xiong. The album features 20 tracks that showcase a blend of raw, melodic bass and vibrant, uplifting rhythms. The project is an exploration of high-energy beats and emotionally resonant soundscapes, creating a cohesive and personal sonic journey.

release.notes: All tracks written and produced by Howard Xiong. 'Radiate' is a digital-only release and is available on all major streaming platforms.
